bridge_only_changes: Real nodes use stable numeric indices, retain real IDs in .real, and expose only visible nodes through the original iterator; actual edges are filtered only by endpoints.

edgeStyle is literal; true effective_w/w are clamped through synapseMetrics, real cumulative recalls are normalized through recallActivity into the original 0-100 activity input. No monthly-frequency claims.
Original project calls are bridged to host projectLocal using normalized graphScale and graph-y/world-y conversion. Screen solid-core radius is compensated through original n.size * ratio * zoom.
Node lifetime alpha is applied by rgba through the original per-node screen read; no change to drawNodes source. Actual active recall map supplies dimming only.
A context proxy suppresses duplicate node labels/backplates because original application owns naming/inspector. Original guide text and all core/edge drawing remain unchanged.

Dust generator is the literal original distribution (950/hub,38/leaf), deterministically seeded from actual IDs, with 14k cloud budget. Lexical Math.ceil bounds the original edge-sheath count so clouds + sheath/passive particles remain <=18k.
Explicit original pulses are triggered only by newly observed actual result trail/lit edges, not fabricated activity. No DOM, clock, network, store or graph mutations.
drawGuide delegates the literal drawFlatGuide and skips graphs with fewer than three visible real nodes. Actual category labels replace demo group names.
The original default highlighted core maps to the highest-degree actual visible hub as styling only; host selection and recall counters remain unchanged.
original_context: Isolated visual demonstration approved 2026-11-01, archived verbatim as a non-executable text fixture.
layout_bridge: Stable real ID/category slots, cumulative recall activity and world-scale conversion; archived flatPosition itself unchanged.
